crossRefs.note: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested…
“Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
“Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.”
When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he fainted, and…
God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”

translations.web: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”
translations.bsb: If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me right now—if I have found favor in Your eyes—and let me not see my own wretchedness.”
translations.kjv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
translations.asv: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favor in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
